caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional carved figure of a chubby, unclothed child with light skin and dark, wavy hair sitting atop a horizontal red barrel with black ends. The barrel has the number "1776" inscribed in black on a circular end. The child is holding a basket filled with various fruits, which are colored in greens, purples, reds, and yellows, appearing to include grapes, apples, pears, and possibly other produce. The child's eyes are large and blue, and its cheeks are round and pink. The barrel rests on a rectangular, tiered, dark brown wooden base. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, and the composition is centered with the figure and base occupying the main portion of the image. The artist's signature "Alvin M. Guich, 1937" is written in the lower right corner.
title: The Windham Bacchus
